headline: Accounts and trading volumes surge; dividend lifted sharply
summary_short: Interactive Brokers' Q3 2026 net revenues were $1.91B (+15% y/y) with diluted EPS of $0.69 (adjusted $0.67); customer accounts grew 35% to 5.58M.
summary_long: Net interest income rose 19% to $1.15B on higher customer margin loans and credit balances, and commissions rose 12% to $602M on 18% higher DARTs. Customer equity reached $964.7B and margin loans $105.2B. Execution and clearing costs rose 46%, mainly from higher SEC regulatory fees. Pretax margin was 78%, versus 79% a year ago. Total equity was $23.3B. The board raised the quarterly dividend from $0.0875 to $0.15 per share. No numeric guidance was given.
confidence_notes: Net revenue y/y growth (+15%) is computed from the release's $1.91B and $1.66B reported figures. Adjusted figures are the company's non-GAAP measures excluding currency diversification effects.

drivers.explanation: Higher average customer margin loans and customer credit balances.
18% higher DARTs and higher regulatory fees passed through to customers; futures volume rose while stocks and options volumes fell.
Growth in accounts, equity and margin loans lifted revenue; a higher SEC Section 31 fee rate raised execution costs.
